rules.heading: Code
rules.text: Every endpoint returns the envelope `ApiResponse` — `ok(data)`, `ok(items, PageMeta.of(page, size, total))`, `fail(code, message)`. Never a bare list, entity or `Map`.

rules.heading: Code
rules.text: Pagination is 1-based `page` and `size`: `Math.max(page, 1)` and `Math.clamp(size, 1, MAX_PAGE_SIZE)` with `private static final int MAX_PAGE_SIZE = 100`.

rules.heading: Code
rules.text: DTOs are `record`s grouped in `<Feature>Dtos`. Dependencies are `private final` fields set by an explicit constructor. No Lombok, no field `@Autowired` in production code.

rules.heading: Code
rules.text: Domain errors: throw `ApiException(status, CODE, message)`; `GlobalExceptionHandler` maps it. No try/catch in controllers.

rules.heading: Code
rules.text: Notes are never deleted. "Delete" means archive (`archived = true`); listings exclude archived notes.

rules.heading: Workflow
rules.text: Before you say a change is done, run `mvn -q -o test` and report the result. If it fails, fix it first.

rules.heading: Workflow
rules.text: Never `git push --force`, `git reset --hard`, or `git clean -f` in this repo.

rules.heading: notes-conventions
rules.text: New request/response shapes go into the feature's `XDtos` as `record`s; validate with `@Valid`.

rules.heading: notes-conventions
rules.text: Services own the rules: paging, archiving (never physical deletion), and `ApiException` for domain errors.

rules.heading: notes-conventions
rules.text: Add a test in `src/test/java` for every new endpoint (MockMvc, asserting the envelope), then run `mvn -q -o test` and quote the result in your final message.
